task: Deliver authenticated DELETE /api/articles/:slug/comments/:id as its own API PR stacked on PR #62.
acceptanceCriteria: DELETE /api/articles/:slug/comments/:id requires a valid token; the comment owner gets an empty HTTP 204 and only the selected comment is removed.

Non-integer IDs return 422; unknown articles return 404 with errors.article; missing or wrong-article comments return 404 with errors.comment; non-owners return 403 with errors.comment and no mutation.
The delete resolves and locks the article before the scoped comment, checks author ownership, deletes in the same transaction, and maps persistence failures to the generic 500 response.

Generated Swagger and static OpenAPI document 204, 401, 403, 404, 422 and 500; Hurl and E2E exercise their supported contracts, including non-owner authorization, while E2E injects persistence failure. Existing POST and GET comment behavior remains intact.
blastRadius: Comment ownership and article-scoped not-found behavior
contracts: One API endpoint per PR; base is Phase 5C PR #62.
A comment may only be deleted by its author.
A comment ID is always scoped to the supplied article slug.
Failed authorization and lookup cases do not mutate comments.
